summary: IRS-P3 was an experimental earth observation mission carried out by ISRO, the Indian Space Research Organisation. Its objective was processing and interpreting data from two payloads, the Wide Field sensor and the Modular Optoelectric Sensor, which were developed by the German Aerospace Center. The note is very brief and gives no launch date or orbital details.
one_line: IRS-P3 was an experimental ISRO earth observation mission that processed data from two German-developed payloads.
key_facts: IRS-P3 was an experimental earth observation mission undertaken by ISRO.
The objective of the IRS-P3 mission was processing and interpretation of data generated by its two payloads.
One payload of IRS-P3 was the Wide Field sensor.
The second payload of IRS-P3 was the Modular Optoelectric Sensor.
The Wide Field sensor and Modular Optoelectric Sensor were developed by the German Aerospace Center.
